text:
Morgan: hey team, handing off the evening rotation. keeping this thread as the single source for ongoing alerts + mitigations. primary = Morgan, secondary = Alex. coverage window: 20:00-04:00 PT.

Morgan: current status: Active alert group 'embeddings-p99-spike' firing in us-west-2 for ~35m. impact: degraded embeddings throughput for a subset of customers (approx 4% of requests hitting p99>2.5s). no widespread 5xx.

incident-bot: ALERT: embeddings-p99-spike | fired 4512345300 | severity: high | links: https://monitoring/redwood/alerts/embeddings-p99-spike

Alex: I was on it earlier — background: after the 18:30 deploy we saw host-level KV cache misses spike on primaries. root suspected: cache eviction due to a mis-sized prefix cache config on the new model variant rollout.

Priya: confirmed. rollout includes model v2-quant (canary) that has larger KV footprint. autoscaler hasn't spun additional primaries because rollover policy prevented extra nodes.

Morgan: mitigations in progress: 1) temporarily revert canary to v2-quantless on the small pool (command below), 2) scale up primaries by +2 in us-west-2, 3) enable fallback to warm-model-cache for embeddings route.

Morgan: commands executed so far:
```
# scale group
redwood infra scale --region us-west-2 --pool embeddings-primary --count +2
# rollback canary
redwood model rollback --model embeddings-model --to-version v2-ops-stable
```

Sam: customer-facing update queued? I can push a short note to impacted workspaces: "We're seeing higher embeddings latency for a small group of customers; we're actively mitigating and will update in 30m."

Morgan: yes please. mark it informational (no data loss). include ETA ~30-45m.

Alex: monitoring shows tail improving after scale up (p95 down from 1.9s -> 1.2s, p99 trending down). KV miss rate dropped ~60%. still seeing sporadic misses on older primaries.

Priya: additional actions: adjust prefix cache size in runtime for v2 variants to 1.5x and push config to the canary-only pool after we confirm stability. runbook pointer: https://confluence/redwood/runbooks/embeddings-kv-eviction (see section "refix-cache-tuning").

Morgan: note for next shift: primary -> Alex, secondary -> Priya at 00:00 PT. please watch for regen of alerts after config push.

Alex: I'll take primary at 00:00. plan: keep extra capacity until 03:00, then step down if metrics stable for 30m.

Morgan: outstanding items / TODOs for incoming:
- confirm rollback fully propagated across us-west-2 (check `redwood model status --model embeddings-model --region us-west-2`)
- watch embedding request queue lengths and kv_cache_misses (dashboards linked in the runbook)
- keep customer note updated if ETA changes
- if p99 >3s for >15m after rollback, escalate to oncall-sre-list and consider read-only fallback on the route

Priya: quick troubleshooting snippet to check KV cache miss heatmap:
```
# query metrics
curl -s "https://metrics/api/query?expr=kv_cache_miss_rate{region=\"us-west-2\",pool=\"embeddings-primary\"}" | jq .
```

incident-bot: NOTE: pager suppression active for embeddings-p99-spike until 4512346500 while oncall is mitigating. automatic paging will resume after suppression window.

Morgan: customer impact details captured here: 2 enterprise customers (IDs redacted) seeing degraded embeddings in non-critical paths; no data corruption. Support ticket #ENG-7843.

Sam: added the support ticket link to the status note and pinged the account managers.

Alex: logging what I changed: increased pool by +2 (hosts i-0abc, i-0def), rolled back canary at 4512345405, enabled warm-cache fallback for embeddings-route.

Priya: will prepare the config patch to increase prefix_cache by 50% for v2 variants; will only roll to canary after we confirm latency stable for 20m.

Morgan: last checks before I go offline in 40m: verify p99 trend, confirm no new alerts, confirm ticket updated. If anything regresses, @Alex will escalate.

Alex: ack. I'll take point at 00:00 and post a short handoff note then. :thumbsup:

Morgan: thanks — leaving detailed notes above. signing off for now, reach me on pager if needed. :wave:
